verdict.rationale: Notion lists a GitHub integration ('Keep your GitHub and Notion workflows in sync') and offers a general REST API plus webhooks that could be used to build custom bi-directional sync between Notion databases and an issue tracker, but there is no documented native two-way sync of task/issue state (e.g., status changes propagating both directions) — the GitHub integration description is thin and unverified beyond a marketing tagline, and an older community comment even complains Notion 'does not have a GitHub integration.' missing for 10: concrete documentation of bi-directional field/status sync with GitHub Issues (or Jira/Linear), and independent confirmation the integration goes beyond simple embeds/linking.
